sections.title: Runs and reviewer decisions
sections.sql: SELECT name,environment,revision,current_revision,row_count,decision,blockers,retention_due FROM run_register ORDER BY created_at DESC
sections.note: Run readiness before use. This register shows recorded decisions and revisions, not current rule equivalence.

sections.title: Field treatment
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM rule_coverage ORDER BY object_name

sections.title: Follow-up register
sections.sql: SELECT * FROM attention ORDER BY kind,item

sections.title: Retained fields needing inspection
sections.sql: SELECT object_name,field_name,reason FROM field_rules WHERE action='keep'

sections.title: Purpose, owner and review date
sections.sql: SELECT name,owner,purpose,retention_due,days_left,runs,stored_rows FROM retention_review ORDER BY retention_due
